Anime Corner News on Instagram: "NEWS: Crunchyroll was hit with another class action lawsuit, this time for the alleged major breach on March 12, 2026.

Follow @animecornernews for all the latest updates!

While many claims are unconfirmed, the lawsuit seeks to establish facts while alleging Crunchyroll was negligent in its data security through its third party vendor, has failed to clearly and timely notify customers, and did not accurately encrypt consumers' personally identifiable information.

Among other things, the plaintiff is seeking:

• All monetary and non-monetary relief allowed by law
• Actual damages
• Treble damages (up to $25,000 per affected Class Member)
• Injunctive relief
• Attorneys' fees and costs
• A court order requiring Crunchyroll to implement proper data security and training programs
• A court order forcing Crunchyroll to inform users on what data, if any, was stolen, and its associated risks

This is the second class action lawsuit against Crunchyroll this month, after plaintiffs alleged that Crunchyroll’s app was sending customer viewing habits to Braze to build marketing profiles.

#crunchyroll #animenews #crunchyrollnews"
